body.statement: Uniformly over \(\mathcal M\), \(\|\widehat w_\ell-w_\ell\|_2=O_{\Pr}(n_\ell^{-1/2})\), with curvature supplied by \(v^\top H_\ell v\geq\lambda\|v\|_2^2\) on \(L\) at every \(\ell\).  Along every extracted subsequence for which \(w_\ell\to w^0\), \(H_\ell\to H\), \(\Omega_\ell\to\Omega\), and \(\sqrt{n_\ell}w_{\ell j}\to h_j\in[0,\infty]\), the empirical pre score converges to \(g\sim N_L(0,\Omega)\) and \(\sqrt{n_\ell}(\widehat w_\ell-w_\ell)\Rightarrow V_h\), where only the subsequential limit criterion defining \(V_h\) uses \(H\).  Moreover, \(A_t(V_h)=0\) almost surely if and only if all donor post-period quantile functions coincide almost everywhere; a projection face contributes an atom at zero exactly when that face lies in \(\ker M_t\).
